message.kimetsunoyaibamultiplayer.final_: Final Selection is a selective process for individuals who seek to become recognized Demon Slayers of the Demon Slayer Corps.
The exam requires surviving seven consecutive nights on the mountain summit, relying entirely on your own resources without outside assistance.
Candidates who successfully survive all seven nights earn the opportunity to join the esteemed ranks of the Demon Slayer Corps as official Demon Slayers.
Final Selection raid is disabled by config.
Return to Kanata or Kiriya to complete Final Selection.
Congratulations %s, you survived Final Selection. You have been issued a Demon Slayer uniform and a Kasugai Crow. Please select an ore for your new Nichirin blade.
[Final Selection] Choose your Scarlet Ore before leaving.
You failed Final Selection, but you can still serve the Demon Slayer Corps as a Kakushi. Do you accept?
Could not find the Overworld to return you.
You joined the Kakushi and received your uniform.
